findings.title: Arbitrary family symbol may not support point-based placement
findings.body: The command selects the first structural-foundation FamilySymbol having writable parameters named Length and Width, but does not verify that its family placement type supports NewFamilyInstance(XYZ, FamilySymbol, Level, StructuralType). A face-hosted or otherwise incompatible symbol can therefore make the entire transaction fail, even when a compatible isolated-footing family exists later in the collector. Filter for a compatible placement type or require explicit type selection.

findings.title: Area heuristic accepts non-rectangular CAD outlines
findings.body: The code treats any polygon whose area is within 10% of its oriented bounding-box area as rectangular. Trapezoids, chamfered outlines, and polygons with small notches can satisfy this condition and be replaced with a full rectangular foundation, producing incorrect geometry. Validate four orthogonal corners/edges within an explicit geometric tolerance instead of relying only on area similarity.

findings.title: Empty extraction is reported as successful placement
findings.body: ExtractFoundationData can legitimately return an empty list for a missing layer, unsupported line geometry, or malformed outlines, but the command still commits and returns Result.Succeeded with 'Created 0 foundations.' This makes input or parsing failures indistinguishable from successful feature execution. Detect an empty result before opening the transaction and return a clear failure or user-facing warning.
